name: jengo/search
description: First-party full-text search engine integration (Meilisearch, Typesense, Database) with zero heavy third-party SDK dependencies for CodeIgniter 4 and the Jengo Framework.

facade.description: Primary static entry point providing fluent search querying, document index management, driver switching, settings syncing, and testing fakes.

manager.description: Search manager handling driver lifecycle and resolution.

query_builder.description: Fluent search query builder supporting filters, sorting, facets, highlighting, pagination, raw engine responses, and entity mapping.

drivers.name: meilisearch
drivers.description: Meilisearch REST driver with typo tolerance, instant search, dynamic ranking rules, and highlighted attributes.

drivers.name: typesense
drivers.description: Typesense REST driver with schema syncing, multi-field searching, NDJSON batch imports, and faceted filtering.

drivers.name: database
drivers.description: Zero-dependency full-text database driver utilizing MySQL FULLTEXT MATCH() AGAINST() or LIKE fallback.

drivers.name: null
drivers.description: No-op driver for local environments or staging where search is disabled.

drivers.name: fake
drivers.description: In-memory test double driver for inspecting indexing operations and asserting query execution.

attributes.description: Attribute to configure search index name, engine, and primary key on models or entities.

traits.description: Model trait hooking into CI4 model insert/update/delete events to auto-sync search documents.

helpers.name: search
helpers.description: Helper function returning a SearchQueryBuilder if query or index is passed, or SearchManager otherwise.

commands.name: jengo:search import
commands.description: Batch import model records into search engine.

commands.name: jengo:search flush
commands.description: Clear all documents from a search index.

commands.name: jengo:search sync-settings
commands.description: Sync index filterable/sortable/searchable attributes to search engine.

commands.name: jengo:search status
commands.description: Check connection status and health of the search engine.

installers.description: Publishes default Search configuration into app/Config/Search.php.
